scope: offline Messages compatibility, source policies fixed separately from provider availability
normal_sequence: pair actual ordered receipts by tool_use_id
fault_sequences: logical named or required with thinking on projects to auto; wrong, absent or repeated emit_result keeps actual usage without default repair
pause_turn retains the original server_tool_use; follow-up uses a new logical reservation in the same root
server result error pairs only to its server id, never invokes local tools
incomplete or duplicate local tool call preserves original attempt without dispatch
failed or unknown local receipt yields is_error with original ID
